description: Returns a combined summary of change order and invoicing information for a specific commitment contract (Purchase Order or Work Order).

data.description: Combined Contract Summary containing both change order and invoicing information

approved_change_total.description: Sum of the grand totals of all approved change orders on the contract, as a decimal string. Add to the original contract value to compute the current revised contract amount.

approved_change_total_tax_amount.description: Sum of the tax amounts of all approved change orders on the contract, as a decimal string.

pending_revised_change_total.description: Sum of the grand totals of all pending or revised change orders on the contract, as a decimal string. Represents in-flight changes not yet approved.

pending_revised_change_total_tax_amount.description: Sum of the tax amounts of all pending or revised change orders on the contract, as a decimal string.

draft_change_total.description: Sum of the grand totals of all draft change orders on the contract, as a decimal string. Represents changes not yet submitted for approval.

draft_change_total_tax_amount.description: Sum of the tax amounts of all draft change orders on the contract, as a decimal string.

total_invoices_amount.description: Total amount billed against the contract to date across all invoices, as a decimal string. Compare against the revised contract amount to gauge billing progress.

total_payments_amount.description: Total amount paid on the contract to date across all payments, as a decimal string. May trail total_invoices_amount when invoices are billed but not yet paid.

currency_configuration.description: Currency configuration for the contract's financial entity.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR) in which the summary amounts are expressed. Null when the financial entity has no configured currency.
